slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: an active couple's ring in real life, signalling 'beautiful and practical' before the reader scrolls.
slots.shot_brief: A low-profile engagement ring (bezel or low six-claw set) on a hand resting on a backpack strap or a weathered rock on a coastal trail, soft late-afternoon light, skin and ring in sharp focus, background a soft blur with no recognisable landmark. One hand only, no face, no visible brands or logos. Landscape 3:2 with space for a title crop. Real licensed photography preferred (stock bought by a human and registered, or a commissioned shoot).
sourcing_notes: Real photography only (licensed stock bought by a human, or a commissioned shoot); not AI because it shows people outdoors in a setting that could read as a real destination.
Fallback if no licensed photo in time: an AI 'Illustrative image' studio flat-lay of generic low-profile rings on stone and rope textures is acceptable (product only, no place).
